report.condition: Three consecutive streetlight poles (No. SL-2214, SL-2215, SL-2216) non-functional. Lamps intact but no supply at the control junction box.
report.measurements: Pole spacing 30 m; affected dark stretch ≈ 90 m; supply cable insulation damaged at 2 points.
report.observations: Junction box near SL-2215 has burnt connector and water ingress. Cable sheath chewed in one section. Pole no. 2216 slightly tilted.
report.probableCause: Ageing underground supply cable with water ingress at junction box; probable illegal tapping point nearby.
report.recommendedAction: Replace 90 m supply cable + junction box; re-lamp 3 fittings; straighten and grout pole 2216 base.
report.requiredResources: Cable crew + crane lorry (1 day); material from street-lighting store.
report.trafficImpact: Moderate — pedestrian risk at night, low daytime impact. Night work recommended.
report.safetyConcerns: Open live junction box hazard; recommend cordoning during repair.
